def factor_fusion_flow_regime_beta(df):
    """Fusion of price impact beta and momentum magnitude scaled by volume ratio."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    returns = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_chg = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    beta = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=10).cov(vol_chg) / vol_chg.rolling(20, min_periods=10).var().replace(0, np.nan)
    momentum = df_copy["close"].pct_change(10)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    weight = np.abs(momentum) * np.clip(vol_ratio, 0.5, 5.0)
    signal = beta * weight
    df_copy["factor_fusion_flow_regime_beta"] = signal.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_fusion_flow_regime_beta"]
description: Combines price impact beta (sensitivity of returns to volume changes) with absolute momentum strength, scaled by volume ratio, to capture amplified trend-following effects during high-volume periods. The multiplicative fusion introduces nonlinearity, potentially improving MI and IC while staying within the Geometric & Fusion layer.
